system.model: gemini-1.5-flash for classification; rule-first hybrid pipeline. Developed locally against Ollama (llama3.1:8b).
system.preference_demo: m015: always CC Priya on Hartwell & Cho legal mail (applied to m018, m048, m055)

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every message exactly one disposition (reply/archive/defer/delegate/escalate) with a one-line reason, leaving none untouched.
capabilities.observable: Prints a table of all 50 messages with disposition and reason, ending with 'undecided: 0'. Writes decisions.json.

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply grounded in an earlier thread message and records cited message ids.
capabilities.observable: Drafts reply answering m008 containing staging AMQP creds from m003, with 'cited: [m003]'.

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Prevents writing to outbox/ without approval or during dry-run.
capabilities.observable: Logs gated send decisions, displays summary, outputs 'outbox/ writes: 0'. Without --dry-run prompts y/n before writing files.

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Persists stated rules to prefs.json and applies them across independent process runs.
capabilities.observable: Pass 1 records CC preference from m015 into prefs.json. Pass 2 loads prefs.json and automatically adds priya@paperjet.io to drafts for m018.

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Identifies prompt injections in email bodies, leaves messages undeleted, and logs structured refusals.
capabilities.observable: Flags m024, m039, m047, and m017. Zero outbox writes; outputs refusal report without deleting original messages.

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates a 3-pane dashboard (Pending, Flagged, Commitments) with multi-message resolution and conflict detection.
capabilities.observable: Generates dashboard.html. Shows derived deck due date cited to [m038, m040] and flags conflict at Sep 15 15:00 between m010 and m061.

capabilities.name: Unanswered follow-up tracking
capabilities.claim: Filters sent emails with pending action items that have received no reply in >3 days.
capabilities.observable: Lists m044 (sent Sep 2 to Priya requesting invoice approval, unanswered after 3 days).

capabilities.name: Executive morning digest
capabilities.claim: Synthesizes actionable high-priority items, low-priority defers, and noise stats into a concise morning brief.
capabilities.observable: Outputs 3 distinct sections: Needs Immediate Action (m010, m018), Defer/Review, and Auto-Archived (counts of receipts/notifications).

capabilities.name: Constraint-aware meeting scheduler
capabilities.claim: Evaluates calendar invites against persistent time-window constraints (e.g. no meetings before 11:00 AM) and drafts counter-proposals.
capabilities.observable: Identifies that m043 requests a 9:00 AM meeting violating preference m041. Drafts polite decline offering alternative times >= 11:00 AM.
